title: FootyGen | Free Football Quiz & Trivia Games

title: Football Quiz Game Modes
description: Choose your football challenge. Play Scoreline Hero, Football Matrix, Scout's Duel, The Journeyman and Higher or Lower on FootyGen.

title: Scoreline Hero — Football Score Quiz
description: Predict the final scores of classic football matches. Use tactical hints, test your memory and earn XP in the free Scoreline Hero football quiz.
tagline: Remember the match. Name the score.

title: Football Matrix — Player Grid Quiz
description: Solve a nine-cell football grid by matching players to clubs, nations, statistics and trophies. Test your knowledge in the Football Matrix quiz.

title: Scout's Duel — Football Guess Who Game
description: Identify the secret footballer before your opponent does. Ask yes-or-no questions and duel an AI scout or a friend in Scout's Duel.
tagline: Find their player before they find yours.

title: The Journeyman — Football Transfer Quiz
description: Recognise a footballer from their club career. Follow transfer trails, reveal clues and identify players in The Journeyman football quiz.
tagline: Follow the clubs. Find the player.

title: Higher or Lower — Football Value Quiz
description: Which footballer has the higher value? Compare players, make your picks and build a streak in the Higher or Lower football quiz on FootyGen.
tagline: Make the pick. Build your streak.
